verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented feature that proactively surfaces past meetings with the same attendees, or generates a brief of open threads, before an upcoming call. What exists is adjacent only: an API filter for transcripts by attendee emails, which is a developer building block, and AskFred's on-demand questions across past meetings, which the user must initiate after the fact. Neither counts as the product delivering pre-meeting prep.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call

citations.quote: Filter meetings that contain any of these emails as attendees. Accepts an array of email addresses.
Query individual meetings or search across multiple meetings to get intelligent, context-aware answers.
